pages.body_md:
This wiki is the team's shared memory. People and agents read it; agents keep it current.

Start at the index: every page with its one-line summary and source count. Follow cross-links to move between pages, and watch the activity log to see what changed and when.

Good answers get filed back here as new pages — ask a question, keep the synthesis. How pages, summaries, sources, and the log fit together lives in [[index-conventions]]; the habit that makes it all work is [[llm-bookkeeping]].
pages.title: Wiki overview

pages.body_md:
Three layers. Raw sources live outside the wiki and are never edited — threads, docs, decisions, wherever the team already keeps them. The wiki layer (pages, index, log) is owned by the agent that maintains it. This skill text is the schema.

Each page carries a title, a one-line summary (the first line of its body), a source list, and a visibility. The index shows every page, orphans under their own heading so [[overview]] always has something to point lint at. The log is append-only: ingest, query, lint.

Pages link with double-bracketed slugs. A link whose slug has no page renders as a dangling link — either a page to write or a slug to fix.
pages.title: Index conventions

pages.body_md:
A team accumulates knowledge faster than it organizes it. Retrieval-only tools re-derive the synthesis on every question; a wiki compounds instead — cross-references already linked, contradictions already flagged, each answer filed back for the next question.

The LLM does the bookkeeping it never gets bored of: ingest compiles sources into pages, query answers from the index with citations, lint checks the whole thing on request. Humans curate sources and ask the questions. See [[overview]] for how to read this wiki and [[index-conventions]] for the layers that keep it honest.
pages.title: The bookkeeping habit

description: A shared knowledge base with an index, cross-linked pages, an activity log, and a knowledge graph — plus the skill that keeps it current.
